metadata.name: Redhair Quality — Full setup
metadata.description: Customizable Redhair defaults with service onboarding, add-on selection and four formatter previews.
metadata.author: Local adaptation

inputs.name: Customize before applying
inputs.description: Choose your services in the Services step, then customize the four groups below. Switch off any section to preserve it. For SEL-only updates, choose the Update existing setup template instead. Service selection is applied separately from these section switches. Proxy settings and user variants are always preserved.

inputs.name: Quality and ranking
inputs.description: Enable the sections you want to replace; switch off anything you want to keep.

subOptions.name: Apply SEL and regex
subOptions.description: All stream expressions, regex patterns, synced URLs and score overrides. Replaces the selected section, including custom SEL edits. Off keeps your current settings.

subOptions.name: Apply Basic filters
subOptions.description: Resolution, quality, language, audio/video, keyword, cached-stream and other basic filters. Off keeps your current settings.

subOptions.name: Apply Sorting
subOptions.description: All cached, uncached, movie, series and anime sort orders. Off keeps your current settings.

subOptions.name: Apply Result, size and bitrate limits
subOptions.description: Result counts, size ranges and bitrate settings. Off keeps your current settings.

subOptions.name: Apply Metadata matching and SeaDex
subOptions.description: Year/title/episode matching, language inference and SeaDex enablement. Off keeps your current settings.

subOptions.name: Apply Deduplication
subOptions.description: Duplicate handling and grouping rules. Off keeps your current settings.

inputs.name: Add-ons and connections
inputs.description: Enable the sections you want to replace; switch off anything you want to keep.

subOptions.name: Apply Add-ons, catalogs and fetching
subOptions.description: Add-on list, category colors, catalogs, groups and dynamic fetching. Includes connection placeholders for your own endpoints. Off keeps your current settings.

subOptions.name: Add-ons to include
subOptions.description: Starts with Redhair’s enabled add-ons. Select any optional add-ons too. This replaces the add-on list; deselected entries are omitted and do not request credentials. Enter your own endpoints on the Credentials screen.

subOptions.name: Add-on service assignments
subOptions.description: Use enabled services lets each add-on use your enabled services that it supports. Redhair assignments retains the original TorBox / AIOStreams / NZBDAV restrictions. Catalog customizations tied to those assignments are only applied in Redhair mode.

options.label: Use my enabled services (recommended for new setup)

subOptions.name: Add-on timeout
subOptions.description: Keep Redhair’s 4–5 second timeouts or allow slower sources more time.

inputs.name: Appearance
inputs.description: Enable the sections you want to replace; switch off anything you want to keep.

subOptions.name: Apply Formatter and posters
subOptions.description: Stream display formatter and poster service selection. Off keeps your current settings.

subOptions.name: Formatter style
subOptions.description: Select a style to see its sample below. All four use Redhair’s Best / Tier scoring. The three Jeormatter layouts keep their original structure.
